fn.en: Say how often you do things.
fn.ru: Говорить, как часто ты что-то делаешь.
fn.kk: Бір нәрсені қаншалықты жиі істейтініңді айту.

can.en: I can say how often I do things.
can.ru: Я могу сказать, как часто я что-то делаю.
can.kk: Бір нәрсені қаншалықты жиі істейтінімді айта аламын.

tip.en: Frequency words go before the verb, but after am/is/are: I always work · I am always late.
tip.ru: Наречия частоты — перед глаголом, но после am/is/are: I always work · I am always late.
tip.kk: Жиілік үстеуі етістіктің алдында, бірақ am/is/are-дан кейін: I always work · I am always late.

items.why: never is already negative — no don’t with it.

items.s: I ___ check my emails first — every single morning. 💯
I ___ walk to work, but usually I drive. 🟡
She goes to the gym ___ a week. 2️⃣
___ often do you see your parents? ❔
My brother ___ works at the weekend. 🟢

items.a: I always get up at six
She sometimes goes to the cinema
Do you study English every day

lines: I [always|am always|always am] get up at six. I [never|not never|don’t never] use my phone in bed.
I [usually|usual|usually am] walk to work, but I [sometimes|sometime|some times] drive.
My sister [doesn’t|don’t|not] walk. She [goes|go|does go] by bus every day.
[Do|Does|Are] you study English every day? — No, [I don’t|I doesn’t|I not].
[How often|How many|How much] do you see your parents? — [Twice|Two times a|Two] a week.

tts: We don’t work near the centre.
Christina doesn’t live in New York.

acts.title: How I get to work
text: I’m Christina. I live in Copenhagen and I always go by bicycle. 🚲
I don’t go by bus, because my house is fifteen minutes from my office.
My colleague Pedro lives in São Paulo. He usually drives with his brother. 🚗
Tai is a student in Hanoi. He doesn’t drive; he never uses a car. 🛵

items.s: Pedro and his brother like buses.

items.sit: You drink coffee every single morning without exception.
o: I always drink coffee in the morning.
I drink always coffee in the morning.

items.sit: You have never smoked in your life.
Your sister does not have a car and does not drive.
You want to know how often your colleague goes to the gym.
o: How often do you go to the gym?
How much do you go to the gym?
How often you go to the gym?

items.sit: Someone asks: “Do you walk to work?” You do.
You go to your English class on Monday and Thursday.
o: I go two times in a week.

lines.s: How ___ do you go to the gym? 🏋️
Twice a week. And I ___ walk to work. 💯
No, I ___ drive. I haven’t got a car. 🚫🚗
No, he ___. He goes by train.

write.q: Write 6 sentences: two things you always do, one you sometimes do, one you never do, and two things you don’t do.
write.model: I always get up at six. I always check my emails before breakfast. I sometimes walk to work. I never drink coffee at night. I don’t drive — I haven’t got a car. My brother doesn’t work at the weekend.

speak.q: Answer out loud: How often do you study English? Do you drive to work? Does anyone in your family work at night?
speak.model: I study English twice a week. No, I don’t — I usually walk. Yes, my brother does. He always works at night.
